n5b26f2842d.headline: Introducing funded pensions in Ukraine should have been done long ago – economist
n5b26f2842d.summary: An economist commented that Ukraine should have introduced funded pensions long ago to address issues in its pension system.
n5b26f2842d.why: Pension reform is critical for Ukraine's fiscal sustainability and social stability, influencing long-term economic growth and investor confidence.
